verdict.rationale: Stripe's Treasury fraud guide documents prevention tooling split by owner. Stripe runs automatic risk controls that reduce "your fraud exposure" [stripe-treasury-docs-14]. Platforms must build and operate their own controls for onboarding, bank linking, inbound transfers, returns and negative balances [stripe-treasury-docs-22]. That implies platforms carry residual fraud exposure, but the evidence never explicitly states who absorbs each loss type. missing for 10: an explicit liability allocation for ACH return fraud, card dispute liability, account-takeover loss responsibility, a documented loss-sharing model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
